phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Clap is the most popular CLI argument parser in Rust.**

**Clap features:**

| Feature | Code |
|---------|------|
| Flags | `#[arg(short, long)]` |
| Options | `#[arg(short, long)]` |
| Defaults | `#[arg(default_value_t = 1)]` |
| Subcommands | `#[command(subcommand)]` |
| Help | Auto-generated |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Clap makes CLI argument parsing easy and type-safe."

**When to use Clap:**
| Situation | Use Clap |
|-----------|----------|
| CLI tools | ✅ |
| Complex arguments | ✅ |
| Subcommands | ✅ |
| Production tools | ✅ |
